Kerala Man Dies in Attack on Merchant Vessel Off Ukraine Coast

A man from Kerala has died in an attack on a merchant vessel off the coast of Ukraine. The incident involved an attack on the ship, leading to the fatality. Further details regarding the circumstances of the attack and the identity of the vessel were not immediately available.
